name: Research Plan
notes: Plan of record maintained as versioned Markdown; 12 phases tracked; phase vocabulary matches lifecycle_model.csv. Project board not used (single-author sprint).

name: Activity Tracker
notes: Work reconstructed as a register of RQs, milestones, tasks and decisions. Issue forms + labels added to this repo (.github/) but not exercised as GitHub Issues.

name: Question Register
notes: RQ1-RQ5 defined and stable; every downstream phase names the RQ it answers in its PHASEn_PROGRESS.md. No RQ issues / pinned index.

name: Discussion Space
notes: Deliberation happened in the working session, not in GitHub Discussions. To be used if the project gains collaborators.

name: Documentation Set
evidence: docs/ (23 files), framework/*/README.md, folder READMEs, docs/conventions.md
notes: Strongly realised: charter-equivalent (PHASE1_PROJECT_DEFINITION.md), protocols (RESEARCH_DESIGN.md, LITERATURE_REVIEW.md), methodology per phase, roadmap. Written from project start.

name: Decision Log
notes: Flagship demonstration: 14 decisions, each with context/decision/rationale/alternatives/affects. No paired decision issues (see A2).

name: Linkage Discipline
evidence: DECISION_LOG.md 'Affects' lines; PHASEn_PROGRESS.md handoff sections; framework CSV cross-refs (RE->RM->GC->component); per-phase commits
notes: Document-level linkage is thorough and machine-checkable (scripts verify RE/RM/GC/component references). Commit->issue and PR->issue linkage absent (few commits, no issues).

name: Change History
evidence: git history: 8 commits labelled Phase 1..Phase 7; origin/main remote
notes: Real, attributable history; commits are phase-scoped. Thin (single author, per-phase batches); no tags yet.

name: Artifact Workspace
evidence: repo layout: docs/ literature/ data/ analysis/ framework/ template/ manuscript/ results/ SOTA/; data/raw gitignored with pointers
notes: Matches REPOSITORY_ARCHITECTURE.md and the template. Large OpenAlex dumps kept out of Git (data/raw/*.jsonl in .gitignore); corpus.csv tracked.

name: Review Workflow
notes: Single-author sprint: no feature branches, no PRs. PR template + CONTRIBUTING added for when the project has reviewers.

name: Automation Suite
evidence: analysis/scripts/*.py (10 scripts regenerate all tables); .github/workflows/validate-structure.yml added
notes: The 'everything regenerable' principle is realised manually — every results/ table comes from a versioned script. No GitHub Actions runs yet.

name: Release Process
notes: CHANGELOG kept in Keep-a-Changelog form against roadmap release points; CITATION.cff and release checklist in place. No tags/Releases cut yet; planned at Phase 12.

name: Archival Bridge
notes: GitHub-Zenodo webhook + DOI: Phase 12. Connects to the prior GitHub-Zenodo-ORCID workflow.

name: Governance Setup
evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE, CITATION.cff added this phase; PHASE1_PROJECT_DEFINITION.md sec6 (scope/boundaries)
notes: Roles implicit (single author = admin). Visibility: repo has origin/main; public-at-publication is the plan.

name: Transparency Surface
notes: Repository not yet public; Pages summary + Insights to follow at publication (Phase 12). Documentation and history are already inspection-ready.
